title: A Closed Form Depth-Width Law for Neural Collapse in Deep Linear Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.21820v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How depth and width of neural networks shape learned representations is usually studied only after training. We show that, in a tractable feature-learning setting, this dependence can instead be obtained in closed form. Using neural collapse as a probe of representation geometry, we express NC1--NC3 directly in terms of the learned feature kernel, extending an identity known for NC1 to the angular part of NC2 and to NC3 under a ridge readout. For deep linear networks with exchangeable class structure, the resulting kernel equations yield a geometric law, exact within the theory, for the layerwise evolution of within-class variability. At large width, the accumulated compression becomes a function of the depth-to-width ratio $L/N$, with its rate determined self-consistently by the data, prior and architecture. translated_title: 深度线性网络中神经坍缩的闭式深度-宽度定律
translated_abstract: 神经网络的深度和宽度如何塑造学习到的表示，通常只能在训练之后才被研究。我们证明，在一个易于处理的特征学习设定中，这种依赖关系可以以闭式形式获得。以神经坍缩作为表示几何的探针，我们直接用学习到的特征核来表达 NC1—NC3，将已知的 NC1 恒等式推广到 NC2 的角度部分，以及在岭回归读出下的 NC3。对于具有可交换类别结构的深度线性网络，由此得到的核方程给出了一个几何定律（在理论范围内是精确的），描述了类内变异性的逐层演化。在大宽度极限下，累积压缩成为深度-宽度比 $L/N$ 的函数，其速率由数据、先验和架构自洽地确定。数值实验支持所推导出的对深度、宽度和信噪比的依赖关系。其结果是一个表示层面的……
tldr: 该论文首次在深度线性网络中推导出神经坍缩的闭式深度-宽度定律，证明在大宽度极限下类内变异性的累积压缩仅依赖于深度与宽度之比 L/N，且压缩速率由数据、先验和架构自洽决定。
en_tdlr: This paper derives a closed-form depth-width law for neural collapse in deep linear networks, showing that at large width the accumulated within-class variability compression is a function of the depth-to-width ratio L/N, with a rate determined self-consistently by the data, prior, and architecture.
